JLaTeXMath Android 0.2.0, unmodified dependency (ru.noties:jlatexmath-android:0.2.0).
Project: https://github.com/noties/jlatexmath-android
Source archive: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/ru/noties/jlatexmath-android/0.2.0/jlatexmath-android-0.2.0-sources.jar
Library license: GNU GPL version 2 or later, with the independent-module linking exception in LICENSE. See COPYING for GPL terms.
Font license texts are bundled under org/scilab/forge/jlatexmath/fonts/licences in the APK assets.
The RemoteGPT project license applies to its independent modules, not to this library or its fonts.

RemoteGPT uses the public TeX layout API with an independent Canvas adapter.
math_glyphs.json contains original U+00AD glyph outlines extracted without modifying the fonts by tools/generate_math_glyphs.py.
These outlines retain the licenses of their source fonts, bundled in the APK as described above.
